pictures.scene: the inner court of a great ancient stone sanctuary at night, its huge plain walls rising away out of sight, a single small oil lamp burning low down near the floor at the far left and throwing one long warm glow across the worn stone, the whole middle of the picture plain unbroken shadow and bare of everything

an immense night firmament arching over a flat dark plain, a faint band of stars and one low sweep of cloud lying along the horizon at the bottom edge, the whole middle and upper part of the picture plain unbroken deep blue-black expanse and bare of everything

a colossal wall of dark seawater standing upright and unmoving above a bare wet seabed, its far crest catching a low golden light at the left edge, foam kept low down along the very bottom, the whole middle of the picture deep unbroken green-black water and bare of detail

one great curved ram's horn lying alone on bare dark stone, large and simple and set low in the picture, warm light coming across it from low on the right, the whole middle and upper part of the picture plain deep shadow and bare of everything

one ancient wooden lyre standing alone on bare dark stone, its strings catching a thin warm light from low on the left, large and simple and set low in the picture, the whole middle and upper part of the picture plain deep shadow and bare of everything

a pair of great bronze cymbals lying alone on bare dark ground, their worn metal catching a low warm light from the right edge, large and simple and set low in the picture, the whole middle and upper part of the picture plain deep shadow and bare of everything

a wide still land at first light seen from high above, low mist lying along the valleys at the bottom of the picture and the first gold of the sun breaking along the horizon at the far left edge, the whole middle and upper part of the picture plain unbroken deep blue sky and bare of everything

lines.text: Praise Him in His mighty heavens.
Praise Him for His mighty acts;
praise Him for His excellent greatness.
Praise Him with the sound of the horn;
praise Him with the harp and lyre.
Praise Him with tambourine and dancing;
praise Him with strings and flute.
